About the Scholarship

Greenano trains materials scientists in nanomaterials for green-energy applications — batteries, catalysis and energy conversion — coordinated from Université de Lorraine. Its dedicated application portal carries the 2027 campaign dates, document checklist and scholarship details.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Greenano trains materials scientists in nanomaterials for green-energy applications — batteries, catalysis and energy conversion — coordinated from Université de Lorraine. Its dedicated application portal carries the 2027 campaign dates, document checklist and scholarship details.

Programme Highlights

  • Nanomaterials-for-energy specialisation with laboratory-heavy training
  • Dedicated application portal for the 2027 campaign
  • Lorraine coordination with European materials-science partners
  • Graduates enter battery industry, energy materials R&D and doctoral study

Who Should Apply

Materials science, chemistry, physics and chemical-engineering graduates with electrochemistry or nanomaterials interest are the target cohort.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students per the campaign information on the portal.

Deadline and How to Apply

Create an account on the Greenano application portal and follow the 2027 campaign instructions as they are published. Key deadline information: Application campaign for the 2027 intake — dates announced on the application portal.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Greenano Consortium (Université De Lorraine)

The Greenano consortium is coordinated by Université de Lorraine and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in nanomaterials for green-energy technologies with European partners.

Official website: https://greenano-app.univ-lorraine.fr

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: See official page for dates - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
